entry.title: Lie Lie Lie
entry.summary:
Author: krono2011

Rating: Teen And Up AudiencesLanguage: EnglishWords: 339,032Chapters: 108/108Kudos: 1,632

Summary: Marinette Dupain-Cheng's life fell apart. Adrien's discovery that his father was Hawk Moth and that his girlfriend had lied destroyed their relationship. Her mother let her leave the city after Chrysalis's death, releasing her from despair. She didn't go to Shanghai. Uncle Wang needed help with his new restaurant. Goodbye, City of Love, hello Gotham, Capital of Crime. Damian Wayne does not get “dumped.” However, with the high-profile Wayne Gala looming and his brothers actively plotting to mock his solo status, he requires an immediate tactical maneuver: a pretend girlfriend. His designated target? Maps Mizoguchi. Approaching a familiar silhouette with raven hair beneath a tree, he coldly issues a command for a romantic alliance. However, when the girl turns around, he realizes it isn't Maps. Instead, it's a thoroughly bewildered French transfer student clutching a macaron. A lesser man would apologize for the mistake. Damian Wayne? He simply doubles down. She has the right hair color, and she is a variable he can control. “You,” he decides, utterly refusing to admit defeat. “You are an acceptable substitute. Don’t be late.”

Summary: Damian was a boy when Ra’s had been killed. To restore honor and balance back to the Order of Shadows and to the world itself. Now, years later his informant has told him the Miraculous have been activated. Summary: After discovering the Order of the Guardians temple ruins, Talia Al-Ghul took it upon herself to hunt down the Grand Guardian of the miraculous. Upon locating Master Wang Fu, Talia tortured the feeble man into relinquishing Guardianship of the Miracle Box to her. Before relinquishing Guardianship, Wang Fu informed Talia that the miraculous could only be wielded by the reincarnations of previous miraculous wielders. In other words, Talia wouldn’t be able to wield the miraculous herself and thus, wouldn’t be able to access the wish she desired. However, as the newly appointed Grand Guardian, Talia was privy to the identities of the designated miraculous wielders. Talia first discovered the identity of the Ladybug miraculous wielder, whose name didn’t ring a bell. Talia then moved on to discover the identity of the Black Cat mirauclous wielder, who, in a twist of luck, turned out to be her own son. An underlying sense of dread accompanied Talia’s excitement as she recalled what Wang Fu had told her before his untimely death- that the souls of the Black Cat and Ladybug miraculous wielders were linked. Talia hoped the Ladybug miraculous wielder, Marienette Dupain-Cheng, would be a worthy partner for Damian.
